    Donor Weight Distribution Diagnostics for multiout_synth Objects

    weight_diagnostics.Rd

    Summarises the distribution of synthetic control weights across donor units, both at the level of individual treated units and aggregated across all treated units. This is a standard robustness diagnostic in the synthetic control literature: highly concentrated weights (few donors receiving most of the weight) indicate a fragile counterfactual.

    weight_diagnostics(
  fit,
  unit_ids = NULL,
  threshold = 0.01,
  top_n_donors = 10L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    fit

    List returned by multiout_synth().

    unit_ids

    Optional character/numeric vector of length \(N\) (all units). Used to label donor rows in donor_summary. If NULL, uses fit$unit_ids if present, otherwise integer indices.

    threshold

    Numeric. Weight threshold for counting "non-negligible" donors. Default 0.01.

    top_n_donors

    Integer. Number of top donors (by total weight received) to highlight in verbose output. Default 10L.

    verbose

    Logical. Print summary tables. Default TRUE.

    Value

    A list (invisibly) with:

    unit_summary

    Data frame, one row per treated unit, with columns unit_id, N_donors_available, N_eff, max_weight, N_nonzero, gini, entropy_norm.

    donor_summary

    Data frame, one row per donor unit, with columns donor_id, n_used (number of treated units for which this donor has weight > threshold), total_weight (sum across treated units), mean_weight_when_used.

    aggregate

    Named numeric vector of cross-unit summary statistics: mean, median, sd, p10, p90 of N_eff and max_weight; fraction of treated units with max_weight > 0.3; total unique donors used.

    threshold

    The threshold used.

    Metrics

    N_eff

    Effective number of donors: \(1 / \sum_d w_d^2\). Equals 1 when all weight is on one donor; equals the total donor count when weights are uniform. The most interpretable concentration measure.

    Max weight

    Largest single donor weight. Above ~0.3 suggests substantial reliance on a single donor.

    N_nonzero

    Number of donors with weight above threshold.

    Gini

    Gini coefficient of the weight vector. when 0 it is perfectly uniform; when 1 this means all weight is on one donor.

    Entropy

    Shannon entropy: \(-\sum_d w_d \log(w_d)\). Higher = more spread. Normalised by \(\log(N_{\text{donors}})\) to lie in [0, 1].

    See also

    plot_weight_diagnostics, balance_table

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
wd <- weight_diagnostics(fit)

# Plots
plot_weight_diagnostics(wd)

# Access unit-level table
head(wd$unit_summary)

# Donors used by more than 10% of treated units
subset(wd$donor_summary, n_used > 0.1 * nrow(wd$unit_summary))
} # }
